_about: The one list of the strategies (development-plan 3.4). Order matters: the plans unlock the planned ones in this order. live = the status file the bot writes (https://bot.da3m.io/<live>.json). demoSample = trades before the Demo verdict (null: not measured). The site (lib/strategies.ts), the API (backend/app/strategy_catalog.py) and the scripts read it; bot.py and the real-money modules keep their own lists, checked against this file in CI (backend/tests/test_strategy_catalog.py).
